interpretation: Historical initial coverage was 0/6; revised original coverage was 1/6; revised fresh-v2 coverage was 0/8. These failures remain part of the record.
Zero false offers on small synthetic controls does not establish broad reliability. Precision with zero offers is undefined.
Only ready_to_review candidates count as offers. A missed positive is not counted as a pass because the learner abstained.
A single correct offer gives a denominator of one, not robust evidence of high accuracy.
On the final frozen learner, initial coverage was 1/6, fresh-v2 coverage was 1/8, and the first unseen fresh-v3 run covered 1/8. Each suite still failed --require-all.
Across these suites, English positive coverage was 3/11 and Chinese coverage was 0/11. These results do not support a claim of broad bilingual automatic feedback understanding.

All four conflict controls withheld offers. Three displayed an explicit conflicted candidate; one Chinese case only displayed insufficient evidence. Abstention must not be described as complete conflict understanding.

Current tests imported 159 synthetic conversations through the actual host and observed nine disabled-import rejections. They did not assess whether a model followed a confirmed preference in a real delivered answer.

independent_fresh_v4.scope: One frozen fresh-v4 diagnostic. Existing evaluator helpers are unchanged; fixture path is external.
limits: Not a provider or real-user benefit evaluation.
False-positive rate counts ready_to_review offers; safe abstention is not positive coverage.
No learner tuning or fixture edits are part of this run.

interpretation: Initial, fresh-v2 and fresh-v3 are now exposed development regression sets. Their 22/22 positive and 0/34 negative false-offer counts must not be presented as unseen accuracy.
The separate first unseen fresh-v4 run offered one expected preference out of eight positive cases: English 1/4 and Chinese 0/4. It withheld offers on all eight negative controls.
Precision was 1/1 emitted candidate. A denominator of one does not establish broad accuracy, and safe abstention is not positive coverage.
Fresh-v4 has no separately labeled conflict control, so its conflict-abstention metric is undefined; do not borrow conflict success from development suites.
The public runner reproduced all v4 metrics, failure IDs and per-case receipts on the same frozen learner. This is a reproduction, not another independent first evaluation.
All earlier failures are retained under historical_stages. None of these synthetic runs measures real-user benefit, unrestricted semantic understanding or delivered model response quality.
reproduction: Run python3 scripts/evaluate_behavior.py to reproduce fresh-v4 on the checked-out source.
Use --suite initial, --suite fresh-v2, or --suite fresh-v3 for exposed development regression cases. --suite all includes both exposed and independent-origin suites; keep their results separate.
Use --require-all to return exit 1 on missed positives, incorrect extra offers or failed controls. The frozen v4 reproduction returned 1.
Only the clock is fixed; imports, persistence, authorization and habit discovery use the real host.
Historical source and report hashes identify recorded versions; current reruns do not recreate earlier source bytes.
